subject.title: fix(feishu): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should Feishu streamed-media body idle use the existing effective media request timeout, or intentionally introduce a shorter 30-second default?
rationale: Both values are technically plausible, but choosing a shorter default changes shipped behavior for existing users and needs explicit Feishu-owner intent plus upgrade evidence.

options.title: Preserve the effective media timeout
options.body: Reuse the exact resolved timeout supplied to the Feishu SDK client for each chunk-idle wait, retaining the shipped 120-second default and configured overrides.

options.title: Adopt a 30-second body-idle default
options.body: Keep the shorter independent watchdog only with explicit owner approval, user-facing rationale, and proof that slow valid Feishu downloads are not regressed.

recommendation.title: Preserve the effective media timeout
recommendation.body: Reuse the exact resolved timeout supplied to the Feishu SDK client for each chunk-idle wait, retaining the shipped 120-second default and configured overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covered cross-surface Feishu media behavior, making this the strongest current routing signal for the timeout-policy choice.
